## This file holds additional QC which could not be compiled in the multi-qc report.

### Fraction Reads in Peak (FRiP)

This table shows FRiP per sample / caller, and related statistics. These data include all peaks (including non-autosomes and blacklisted sites, which were usually only a small fraction of the data)

```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}

outdir = params["outdir"]
qc_dir= paste0(outdir, "/qc_multisample")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
FRiP = rbind(read_table(paste0(qc_dir, "/genrich_FRiP.txt")) %>%
               mutate(caller = "genrich"),
             read_table(paste0(qc_dir, "/macs3_FRiP.txt")) %>%
               mutate(caller = "macs3")) %>%
  mutate(reads_per_peak = n_reads_in_peaks /n_peaks) %>%
  arrange(sample, caller) %>%
  select(sample, caller, FRiP, n_peaks, n_reads_in_peaks, reads_per_peak, n_mapped_reads)

DT::datatable(FRiP)
```

### macs3 vs. Genrich

This table shows the overlap in (and number of) calls by the two different peak callers, macs3 vs. Genrich. These data are only on autosomes and non-blacklisted sites. 

- "n_macs3/genrich_peaks" is the number of peaks from that caller
- "intersection" and "union" are in # of bases; they are how many bases intersected, and the total number peak bases
- "n_intersections" is the number of intersecting peaks with at least 1 overlapping base.
- "n_50_intersections" is the number of peaks that had >= 50% overlap
- "jaccard" is the fraction of intersecting bases = intersection /  (union - intersection)

```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}

outdir = params["outdir"]
qc_dir= paste0(outdir, "/qc_multisample")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
tbl = read_table(paste0(qc_dir, "/macs3_vs_genrich_intrasample_peak_overlap_metrics.txt")) 
DT::datatable(tbl)
```


### Sample-Sample variation, macs3

This shows the intersection between samples, within the macs3 caller. The columns are defined similarly to the previous section. 


```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}

outdir = params["outdir"]
qc_dir= paste0(outdir, "/qc_multisample")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
tbl = read_table(paste0(qc_dir, "/macs3_intersample_peak_overlap_metrics.txt")) 
DT::datatable(tbl)
```

And here are those data with the jaccard index plotted:

```{r, echo =FALSE, message = FALSE}
tbl %>%
  mutate(jaccard = signif(jaccard,2)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample1, y = sample2, 
             label = jaccard, fill = jaccard))+
  geom_tile()+
  geom_text()+
  theme_minimal(8)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

```
